description: Find US local businesses and enrich them into a lead list: owners and key people with contacts, legal entity, open/closed status, and any custom attribute in plain English. Pay only for answered cells. Free trial at https://app.voygr.tech

interface.shortDescription: Lead lists of US local businesses
interface.longDescription: Search 16M+ US places by city and category, save the matches as a list, then fill the fields you need: owners and key people with email and phone, legal entity, open/closed status, hours, website, or a custom attribute you describe in plain English. Searching and counting are free; you pay per place imported and only for cells that get an answer. The skill sends HTTPS requests to api.voygr.tech with your own API key (free trial at https://app.voygr.tech). US places only.
